$comment: MapMaker Style Packs, Set 1 (04 Orbital Station, 07 Neon Megacity): facade pieces and props we model ourselves in code, and glass-tower tiles fitted from Kenney's City Kit (Commercial). tools/content/prepare-packs.mjs builds packages/client/public/packs (and the prop sources in assets-src/tiletrigger-stylepacks) and writes content/packs.lock.json. The Kenney kit is downloaded, never committed.
